biggest_catch: The $20 is Rover credit, not cash — it is applied toward future Rover bookings and has no cash value, so it only has value if you actually use Rover again.
catches: Both sides get $20 in Rover credit; the friend's $20 applies to their account and yours is a promo code toward your next booking.
Your friend must create a new Rover account through your unique referral link AND complete a qualifying booking (booked and paid for via the Rover platform); signup alone earns nothing.
Your $20 promo code is emailed 24–48 hours after your friend completes their first service; terms say credits are deposited within approximately one week.
Credits are valid for a limited time and may expire; maximum €5,000 in referral credits unless a program states otherwise.
You may not refer members of your household, people you share a pet with, or someone who intends to book care for your pet; no self-referrals.
Referrals only work between users in countries using the same currency.
Rover may modify, cancel, deactivate, or terminate any referral program at any time.
